navi.name: Anika - Animated, Friendly and Engaging
navi.description: Anika is a trusted friend - expressive, clear, and effortlessly engaging. Perfect for animated storytelling or tutorials, it brings an optimistic, authentic tone that connects with young listeners and makes every word resonate. Ideal for projects that need an empathetic, friendly touch.

saria.name: Ayres - Warm, Gentle and Soothing
saria.description: Warm, gentle female voice perfect for audiobooks, storytelling, and YouTube content. Natural and soothing tone with clear articulation, ideal for educational videos, narrative content, and engaging listeners of all ages. Versatile delivery that brings stories to life with authenticity and emotional depth.

arvore_deku.name: James - Deep, Raspy and Grim
arvore_deku.description: A very low, deep, and raspy voice with a UK accent. Perfect for audiobooks as well as narrations or characters for films, video games, documentaries, and even YouTube/TikTok stories.

mido.name: Beto - Native Brazilian Specialist (PT-BR)
mido.description: Authentic Native Brazilian Portuguese (PT-BR) with a Neutral Accent (São Paulo). Professional, deep, and trustworthy. Optimized for YouTube (Finance, True Crime, Tech), Localization, and Corporate Training. Delivers a mature "storyteller" pacing for high audience retention.

zelda_crianca.name: Dara de Alcantara - Soft and Shy

zelda_adulta.name: Amanda Kelly - Sweet, Warm and Clear
zelda_adulta.description: A sweet, feminine, and youthful Brazilian Portuguese voice with a neutral accent. Naturally warm and expressive, she brings a gentle charm to every word. Ideal for narrations, educational content, and conversational dialogue where clarity, softness, and an inviting tone are essential.

sheik.name: Charles - Social Media, TV & Commercial
sheik.description: A bold, charismatic male voice that brings energy, clarity, and authenticity to every project. Perfect for creators, brands, and storytellers who want to connect with modern audiences through powerful, relatable narration. Charles delivers a natural conversational tone that fits seamlessly across every corner of social media — from quick-hit Shorts and TikToks to long-form storytelling and branded campaigns.

ganondorf.name: Miguel - Deep, Emotional & Cinematic
ganondorf.description: Deep Brazilian voice with cinematic emotion, soulful storytelling, and a warm gravely tone perfect for drama, audiobooks, emotional narration, and immersive characters.

rauru.name: Spuds Oxley - Grandpa
rauru.description: A friendly Southern grandpa who knows how to enthrall his audience with tall tales and fun adventures! A warm, friendly, stylized baritone voice that is great for these categories: characters, educational, advertisement, social media, conversational, and entertainment.

impa.name: Andrea Lot - authoritative Brazilian Portuguese voice
impa.description: A rich, deep, and authoritative Brazilian Portuguese voice, specialized in long-form narration and storytelling. With a naturally calm and resonant tone, this voice is perfect for high-end documentaries, educational content, scientific explanations, and immersive audiobooks.

darunia.name: Chris Basetta - Warm, Deep and Engaging
darunia.description: Middle aged warm and calm, voice.  ideal for audiobooks and narrations. You can also use it in English, choosing the American accent for perfect pronunciation.

ruto_crianca.name: Marianne - Customer service
ruto_crianca.description: A young, professional female voice in Brazilian Portuguese, designed for customer service agents. Versatile for support, sales, collections, and virtual assistants—featuring an empathetic, assertive, and natural tone.

ruto_adulta.name: Hope - Professional, Clear and Natural
ruto_adulta.description: A calm, confident, and authoritative voice with clear enunciation—ideal for corporate trainings, tutorials, and IVRs.

rei_zora.name: Joe - Confident Idiot
rei_zora.description: Uneducated, oblivious male. Endlessly opinionated. Great for blunt, rude, annoying and incorrect content. American male. A funny voice by Hey Its Brad.

nabooru.name: Larisa Actrisa - Confident and Clear
nabooru.description: Young Russian female with a gentle voice, perfect for social media use case.

kaepora_gaebora.name: Will - Deep, Smooth and Affectionate
kaepora_gaebora.description: Narration voice for Brazilian children, with a friendly and warm touch. Designed to capture the attention of children, it has smooth and expressive intonations. Ideal for audiobooks, children's stories, and educational content.

malon_crianca.name: Graziella - Children's Narrator
malon_crianca.description: Perfect for children, this clear Brazilian voice has a youthful, lively tone that is ideal for storytelling. Expressive and dynamic, it brings fantasy, fairytale, and other characters to life, creating a magical listening experience. It is also well suited for children’s e-learning content, presenting educational material in a friendly, easy-to-follow, and captivating way.

malon_adulta.name: Marianne - Sweet, Calm and Clear
malon_adulta.description:
A young Brazilian female with a sweet, calm voice and neutral accent.
Specialized on media (youtube, instagram, memes, tiktok, etc) and storytelling/narration (books, articles, news, dubbing, etc).

talon.name: Tarun - Rich, Warm and Friendly
talon.description: This voice has a lively rich timber which elevates the brand communication. The Indian neutral accent is ideal for both, the urban sophisticated youth and the hinterland go getter. A comforting resonance coupled with an elegant delivery that captivates listeners and audiences whilst bringing the client’s message home so as to achieve the intended outcome.

ingo.name: Vagner de Souza - Sharp and Sarcastic
ingo.description: Middle aged male Portuguese voice. Suitable for different jobs, such as: dubbing, narration, and tutorials.

koume.name: Kassandra  - Strange and Tricky
koume.description:
The voice of the Oracle - Kassandras voice carries the weight of an extraordinary life – sometimes warm and grandmotherly, then razor-sharp and bitingly sarcastic.
Perfect for mysterious mentor figures, urban fantasy, wise eccentrics with dark pasts, or any role that combines wisdom with world-weariness and unexpected truths with a touch of cynicism.

kotake.name: Regina - Meditative, Expressive, Soft
kotake.description: Female mature voice. Calm and Deep. Perfect for audiobooks.

vendedor_mascaras.name: Manoel - Serious & Elegant
vendedor_mascaras.description: The voice of a serious professional.

dampe.name: Nunessilva
dampe.description:
A 52-year-old professional with a degree in Philosophy from USP and a specialization in Corporate Communication from FGV. His career spans 25 years as an executive.

Vocal Profile: Medium-low pitch with chest resonance. Full-bodied voice, natural rather than forced | Moderate pace (140–155 words per minute). Strategic pauses of 1–3 seconds after key points |
Steady, with subtle variations for emphasis. No abrupt fluctuations; precise diction. Every syllable is fully articulated.

guru_guru.name: Krishna - Energetic and Expressive
guru_guru.description: Krishna is the pen name of a very talented actor, director, and casting director. Because of his experience both on and off screen, he has a 360-degree view of how a voice should be. You will notice that range and professionalism in his voice. Do give it a try.

grande_fada.name: Iris - Warm, Soothing and Emotional
grande_fada.description: "Iris Romantic" is a soothing voice full of passion and sincere, very human and feminine. Perfect for narrations and conveying emotions.

skull_kid.name: Zozo
skull_kid.description: An animated, expressive, and cheerful voice. Perfect for video game adventure videos!

biggoron.name: W.L. Oxley
biggoron.description: A typical American adult male whose baritone voice is understandable, conversational, honest, and direct. Also great for these categories: characters, narration, educational, advertisement, social media, and entertainment.

narrador.name: David - Deep, Gravelly and Resonnat
narrador.description: Middle-aged man with deep, gravelly voice, special for trailers and epic narrations.
